label: pwsh 可见路由
text: Prefer this bash tool for shell syntax, scripts, pipelines, redirection, globbing and POSIX utilities; use the pwsh tool ONLY when PowerShell cmdlets, registry, services or WMI are truly required.
expected: 只有确实需要 PowerShell cmdlet

label: 拒绝后不切换原生通道
text: Fix failed bash syntax in bash; never embed `pwsh -Command` inside a bash command as a workaround (variable expansion and output encoding break there). Choose a separately offered native route for its documented purpose before execution, never as a policy-denial retry.
expected: 绝不要把它当作策略拒绝后的重试手段

label: pwsh 隐藏路由
text: Prefer this bash tool for shell syntax, scripts, pipelines, redirection, globbing and POSIX utilities — it is this host's shell.

label: 不得臆造隐藏工具
text: Fix failed bash syntax in bash; no PowerShell tool is offered here. Do not invent a hidden tool or embed another interpreter as a workaround.

label: 持久终端方言
text: The persistent terminal tools (terminal_open/read/send/...) run Git Bash (MSYS) on this host: the same drive-root paths (/c/...) and MINGW64 semantics as this bash tool; they are NOT PowerShell.

label: 原生 argv 和编码
text: Use gitbash_native before execution when a Windows .exe needs exact literal argv such as /all or /c without MSYS conversion, or independently declared stdout/stderr encodings. Supply an absolute executable, mark each argument literal or path, and select only a known encoding (raw for unknown/mixed bytes). It does not implement shell pipelines, expansion or .cmd/.bat wrappers; only resolved danger-full-access can execute it.
expected: 只有解析为 danger-full-access 时才能执行

label: 完整路径转换边界
text: Use gitbash_to_native_path only for a complete caller-declared MSYS filesystem path that a native Node fs/path API needs, especially a runtime-built value. Read native_path from the result. Never convert routes, search strings or shell/program source. Already-native or cwd-relative Node paths need no conversion; ordinary tool path fields already use their own translation. Conversion grants no access.
expected: 转换本身不授予任何访问权限

label: 拒绝和解码失败纪律
text: Choose the execution route before running. A policy/access denial is a stop condition: never switch tools, shells or permissions to bypass it. A decoding/display failure does not mean the command failed to run; preserve its exit facts and never blindly repeat a side-effecting command. Do not guess unknown or mixed encodings.
expected: 绝不要盲目重复有副作用的命令
